findings.description: Loamwise-ViT achieved higher clean Harrowfield-Leaf top-1 accuracy than Ferncastle-CNN (91.4% versus 89.7%), with a statistically significant paired mean advantage of 1.7 percentage points across five seeds.
Loamwise-ViT met the pre-specified robustness criterion at every tested JPEG quality from 90 through 10 because its accuracy drop never exceeded 1.8 points, below the 2.0-point limit.
Ferncastle-CNN met the robustness criterion only at JPEG qualities 90 and 70 and exceeded the 2.0-point drop limit at qualities 50, 30 and 10.
Under the most severe tested compression, JPEG quality 10, Loamwise-ViT retained 89.6% accuracy with a 1.8-point drop, whereas Ferncastle-CNN fell to 79.9% with a 9.8-point drop.
The JPEG evidence is limited to mean performance on one test split at five specified quality settings, and the package reports no inferential test or uncertainty interval for the JPEG comparisons.
